description: This file contains a utility enum 'SimpleTaskSupport' providing static methods to manage asynchronous tasks, including starting, stopping, and running a detached loop with interval delays.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous task if not already running, executing the provided async operation.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing task if it exists and resets the task reference.

methods.name: startDetachedLoop
methods.description: Starts a detached asynchronous loop that repeatedly executes the provided async operation at specified intervals, until canceled.
